facts: The national-treasure main keep has three floors under three layers of roof, including kirizuma, irimoya and curved karahafu gables. Upper floors have foliated windows and the third floor has a surrounding railed gallery. The Tsuke and Tamon turrets share the designation.

record: Castle administration site elevations and visitor guide
facts: The main keep stands in the Honmaru at the top of an approximately 50 m climb from the front gate.
